summary: The registrant Capital One Funding, LLC filed an 8-K on behalf of Capital One Multi-Asset Execution Trust to report the upcoming issuance of Class A(2026-1) and Class A(2026-2) asset-backed notes on July 16, 2026. This is a routine ABS securitization transaction under a shelf registration, not a special situation. The filing includes underwriting and terms agreements dated July 9, 2026. No change-of-control, tender, restructuring, or activist event is present. The filing merely satisfies disclosure obligations for a standard note issuance. No further analysis or risk-arb angle applies.
